concepts.def: Young people in society: their values, education, employment prospects and political engagement in the French-speaking world.
Civic and political engagement, including volunteering ('le bénévolat'), protest and voting, through which young people shape society.
The movement of people into France and francophone countries, raising questions of identity, opportunity and social cohesion.
Integration: the process by which newcomers become part of society, debated alongside ideas of assimilation and multiculturalism.
Globalisation: the growing interconnection of economies and cultures, affecting jobs, identity and the French language worldwide.
A society made up of many cultures living together, a key theme in debates about France's changing identity.

walkthroughs.body_html:
Unit 5: A2 Themes (Young People in Society; Our Place in a Changing World) — a core area of A-Level French.

Working through it builds the schema you need: the key terms, how they connect, and how to use them together.

Unit 5: A2 Themes (Young People in Society; Our Place in a Changing World) brings together several ideas you need to use as a set, not in isolation.

Lock in the vocabulary first, then practise pulling the ideas together to answer real questions.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Unit 5: A2 Themes (Young People in Society; Our Place in a Changing World).

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.
